Harper: quick ping — PR #15823 is blocked on CI: shard-7 snapshot mismatch. I pushed a tiny test tweak but CI still shows a diff on `tests/test_retrieval.py::test_prefix`. Can someone either approve a targeted rerun or sign off on a snapshot update if it repros? buildkite: https://buildkite.com/r/redwood/prs/15823 (job: shard-7)
CI Bot: Build 15823 (shard-7) failed: snapshot mismatch in test_prefix. Log: `ASSERT EQUAL` at line 42. Artifacts: /artifacts/15823/shard-7/snap-diff.txt
Maya: out until 4pm PT but can take a look quickly. on first glance is it whitespace/timing noise or actual content change? @Harper any failing diff paste?
Harper: pasting minimal diff below:
```
- expected: ["item1", "item2", "item3"]
+ actual:   ["item2", "item1", "item3"]
```
seems like nondeterministic ordering from retrieval stage (likely flaky). Locally i ran the test 20x and couldn't repro.
Sam: thanks. if it's ordering nondet and locally not repro, i'm comfortable with a targeted rerun first. if the rerun consistently fails, we'll need to dig & either fix the nondet or update snapshot after confirming behavior unchanged.
Jonah: I can approve a run+merge if the rerun passes or if Harper can show a local update test that demonstrates no behavior change. steps to trigger targeted rerun: `bk run --job shard-7 --pr 15823 --targeted` (we also have the web button).
Harper: triggering targeted rerun now via web. leaving note to not auto-update snapshots. also, command i used for local attempts:
```bash
pytest tests/test_retrieval.py::test_prefix -k prefix -q --maxfail=1 -x
```
CI Bot: Targeted rerun queued for PR 15823 (shard-7). New build id: 2415006720.
CI Bot: Build 2415006720 (shard-7) completed: PASSED. No snapshot diffs detected.
Maya: nice — since rerun passed, i'm okay approving merge. no snapshot update needed.
Sam: i'll merge now and kick a full CI smoke after merge to be safe. merging in 2m. :thumbsup:
Harper: thanks everyone! tagging in release notes that this was transient test ordering.
Sam: merged and pushed. full CI queued (build 2415007801).
CI Bot: Full CI build 2415007801 started.
CI Bot: Full CI build 2415007890 completed: PASSED.
Jonah: great, closing the merge hold. thanks for the quick coordination.
Harper: appreciate it — moving on to the next PR.
